Day four of growing a brand new Instagram account from zero, and today we fix the posting schedule. If you only have a few hours a week, keep it simple. Monday, one carousel. Wednesday, one reel. Friday, one reel. Stories on the days in between, two or three each time. If you have more time, add a third reel on Sunday and post stories every day. The posting schedule only works if you can keep it for three months, so pick the one that fits your week, not the one that looks impressive. Consistency beats volume. Save this and plan your week from it.
